Name: Craftable Geodes
Author: sexynes
Description:
Players can unlock craftable frozen geodes, magma geodes, and omni geodes﻿ after acquiring varied mining levels.

Specific information:
[spoiler]Level 4 mining:
Frozen Geode = 3 geodes  

Level 7 mining: 
Magma Geode = 2 frozen geodes and 1 geode  

Level 9 mining: 
Omni Geode = 2 magma geodes, 1 frozen geode, and 1 geode  
[/spoiler] 

[i][size=2]Credits to sydendipitous for the idea. [/size][/i]
